verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference. That API covers workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions, and Jitsu states that jitsu-cli 'does everything the UI does'; an MCP server also exposes pipeline management to agents. The explicit full-parity claim is made for the CLI rather than the raw API. Probes did not find a machine-readable OpenAPI file at the standard paths, but they did not check the cited docs.jitsu.com/api reference, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit API-level UI-parity statement, retrievable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
